g.text: Age and the eye: two influences.
Spectran combines spectral transmission through the ocular media with a model of pupil size.
Transmission varies with λ and age.
Opening size affects the light level.
Model example with a smaller pupil area
Model example for age 65, not a measurement of an individual's eye. Both correction factors equal 1 at age 32.
The melanopic transmission factor also depends on the light spectrum. Model: DIN/TS 5031-100.
